title: KnowledgeEntryInput
description: A new entry captured into the caller's personal layer.

key.description: Stable key; the most specific layer wins for the same key.

source.description: Where this knowledge comes from (URL, document, person).

private.description: Private entries are never proposed, never shown in a leaver review, and are purged when the person leaves (D59). Refused unless the operator has enabled private entries (MUISTAMO_KNOWLEDGE_PRIVATE_ENTRIES).
